sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE' AND arrest = 0
SELECT case_number, crime_date FROM crimes WHERE location_description = 'HOUSE' AND year = 2026 ORDER BY crime_date, crime_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT community_area_id) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id WHERE ca.community_area_name = 'WEST RIDGE'
SELECT i.index_code, COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON c.iucr = i.iucr GROUP BY i.index_code

SELECT ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id WHERE c.domestic = 1 GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT ca.community_area_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.domestic = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS domestic_pct FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id GROUP BY ca.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY domestic_pct DESC, ca.community_area_name

SELECT pd.district_label, COUNT(*) AS homicide_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts pd ON c.district_id = pd.district_id WHERE c.primary_type = 'HOMICIDE' AND c.year = 2026 GROUP BY pd.district_id, pd.district_label

SELECT ca.community_area_name, SUM(strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date) = '2026-07') AS july_count, SUM(strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date) = '2026-08') AS august_count, SUM(strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date) = '2026-07') - SUM(strftime('%Y-%m', c.crime_date) = '2026-08') AS difference FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY difference DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE' AND location_description = 'STREET'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crimes WHERE iucr = '0110' AND domestic = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT beat) FROM crimes WHERE primary_type = 'HOMICIDE' AND location_description = 'HOUSE'

SELECT ca.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas ca ON c.community_area_id = ca.community_area_id WHERE c.location_description = 'RESIDENCE' GROUP BY ca.community_area_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, ca.community_area_name
SELECT i.primary_description, COUNT(*) FROM crimes c JOIN iucr_codes i ON c.iucr = i.iucr WHERE i.index_code = 'N' GROUP BY i.primary_description
SELECT fbi_code, SUM(domestic = 1) AS domestic_count, SUM(domestic = 0) AS non_domestic_count FROM crimes GROUP BY fbi_code
